❯ Review the notes ledger (USER.md). Would a delete tool help?

⏺ Read(prompts/USER.md, internal/brain/notes.go)

⏺ Notes ledger review

  - The ledger keeps at most 5 notes. A 6th note silently pushes the oldest one
    out; nothing tells the CEO.
  - Today 5 of 5 slots are used, and 2 of them are stale: one says the release
    is on Friday 2026-09-26, which has passed; one names a worker, kvoice-old,
    that no longer exists.
  - Consequence: the next note the CEO adds will push out "always ask before
    pushing to main", which is the oldest note and the most important one.
  - A delete tool would let the CEO remove the 2 stale notes by voice ("forget
    the release note"). It is about 60 lines plus tests.
  - Useful but not urgent: nothing is lost until a 6th note is added.
  - Alternative: raise the cap to 10 (one line). That only delays the problem
    and keeps stale notes forever.
